RAW decoder attribution and source availability

PhotoMaster uses the unmodified libraw-wasm 1.6.0 npm distribution.
The JavaScript wrapper declares the ISC license; author: ybouane, with
contributors BeseBarni, lexluthor0304, gwennlbh and hrueger.
Wrapper source and reproducible build scripts:
https://github.com/ybouane/LibRaw-Wasm/tree/32fd36a9883a10c1632bc20073f1ea88cc60487a

The pinned upstream build uses LibRaw 0.22.1 and Little CMS 2.19.1.
LibRaw is available under LGPL 2.1 or CDDL 1.0; this distribution selects
the CDDL 1.0 option. The copyright notices and CDDL license are provided
alongside this file. The corresponding unmodified LibRaw source is at:
https://github.com/LibRaw/LibRaw/tree/0.22.1

Little CMS is MIT licensed. Its license is provided alongside this file.
Source: https://github.com/mm2/Little-CMS/tree/lcms2.19.1

The upstream Emscripten build also uses its libjpeg, libpng and zlib ports.
Source and license references:
https://github.com/emscripten-core/emscripten/tree/5.0.7/tools/ports
https://www.ijg.org/files/README
https://www.libpng.org/pub/png/src/libpng-LICENSE.txt
https://www.zlib.net/zlib_license.html

These third-party components retain their own licenses. They are not
relicensed under PhotoMaster's Apache-2.0 license.
